message.reasoning:
I'm working out the design carefully: the CH and Germany regions, plus ABB Swiss, have no text, and the quant functions only cover US filers, so the only factors that reach those regions are market factors, which don't measure exposure. I'll have to leave those unknown and say so in the rationale. I'm also considering three sub-themes, and I'm about to list the KPIs.

I'm going to make the first KPI a revenue-share measure covering grid equipment, automation, efficiency, demand response, storage, and inverters, sourced from the SEC and ESEF filings. I'm weighing whether to gate it at a small revenue-share threshold so zero-exposure names drop out, and I'm leaning toward a threshold around 0.05 while noting that the unknown CH and DE regions shouldn't count as zero.

I'm sketching the KPIs now: a revenue-share measure for grid, automation, efficiency, demand response, storage, and inverter products, plus a committed grid capex figure for utilities, with judgement items for grid automation and efficiency offerings. I'm also weighing a storage and inverter deployment measure and an R&D intensity metric for US filers only, and wondering where to file it among the sub-themes.

I'm weighing whether to drop the R&D intensity metric, since it measures technology spending rather than exposure to the theme. I'm settling the weights so the four KPIs sum to 100, with the revenue share and storage measures carrying the most weight, and setting the lookback window at 540 days.
